paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在相关工作部分的“多模态融合”小节中，将目标论文作为视觉与毫米波融合的一个例子进行群体引用，并未单独描述或突出目标论文的创新或能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Wang et al. [23] combine the train speed calculated by the mmWave and the loop closure detection result of camera data to accurately locate the train.
evidences.evidence_context: ReID [24] achieves cross-modal human re-identification by analyzing human gait data from vision and mmWave radar. Wang et al. [23] combine the train speed calculated by the mmWave and the loop closure detection result of camera data to accurately locate the train.
evidences.reference_entry: Z. Wang, G. Yu, B. Zhou, P. Wang, and X. Wu, "A train positioning method based-on vision and millimeter-wave radar data fusion," IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, vol. 23, no. 5, pp. 4603-4613, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用[23]对应的参考文献条目是Wang等人2021年关于列车定位的论文，而非目标论文（Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID）。因此，这是一个错误的归因，属于误引用。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 引用论文在群体引用中将目标论文错误指向了另一篇列车定位论文，未涉及目标论文的RFID亚毫米级感知能力。
